conditional_state_contracts.reason: No records to convert or create in this migration. If a future separately authorised store exists, exact canonical ID/block aliases may preserve a bookmark; removed block falls back to its known parent with notice, removed content stays unavailable/tombstoned.

No completion data to convert. Future records require content version plus lesson semantic revision; unchanged lessons may keep credit, changed/split/merged lessons need explicit compatibility review. Old chapter/page coverage never awards new lesson completion.

No history dataset to migrate. Future history needs question ID/revision, option identity/order and original score snapshot. Preserve old outcomes as historical; rewrite/replace does not automatically transfer current mastery.
No schema migration, new database or cloud sync is authorised by 7E. Unknown imported storage is unsupported until separately audited; do not invent progress or infer it from chapter/page references.

viewport_policy.interpretation: Approved preview widths are conceptual, not minimum supported sizes or fixed breakpoints. Do not label 390 px as an approved minimum.
viewport_policy.replay_baseline: 390x844 logical shared/browser viewport, plus actual native target dimensions; measure and record effective viewport, density, image bounds and insets.
viewport_policy.narrow_reflow_probe: 320 logical-pixel width diagnostic in shared/browser runtime, plus 1280-wide desktop/library check. This is test coverage, not a new breakpoint/design approval.
viewport_policy.artwork_minimum: Approved assessment/lesson/review frame height at least 220 dp; wide-reference minimum 380 dp. Equal option sizing and unchanged aspect/white backing; verify actual bounds at target width.
viewport_policy.text_and_themes: light/dark x 1.0/1.6 font scale; never widen viewport or shrink body text to hide overflow.
